page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom left of centre. No marginal notes and no footnotes.

main_text.p: gam[?] monebo te diu Eliezeris Lectioni me diligentius incumbentem sententiam de iftius Libri antiqvitate mutasse, mul-ta enim interlegendum mihi deprehen-disse videor, qvæ tantam antiqvitatem minime sapiunt; qvidqvid Judæi jacti-tent, atqve ille potissimum Rabbinus, qvi Librum excudendum curavit. Ex-empli causa nonnullorum Rabbinorum mentionem facit, qvi post verum Elieze-rem Hircani filium diu vixerunt, qva ratione fretus, scripsit author Libri Ju-chasin, Librum iftum ab Eliezeris disci-pulis suis compositum. Fabulæ insuper Talmudicæ passim intertextæ, loca Scripturæ subtili qvodam, vel potius fu-tili acumine ad rem subjectam detorta, ut Historiolæ explicandis locis Scripturæ difficilibus Talmudico more derepente confictis, longum temp9[?] a Templi ruina, demonstrare mihi videntur, v. g. initio capitis sexti Talmudica ista fabula refer-tur, qvæ etiam extat in Beresith Rabba, narraturqve à Rabbi Salomone 'in pri-mum caput Genef, velut qvid maxmieno[?]

page.notes: The first word is a large initial that reads as "gam", probably "iam" in the printer's type, so it is marked [?]. "temp9" is printed as such and may be an old abbreviation for "tempus"; it is kept as printed. "maxmieno" at the line end is probably "maximè" plus a continuation, and the word is unclear, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "tan-" and the signature "Q 6" are kept outside the text. The running head is shown in small capitals and copied as "D VENDELINUS".
